title: Adolfo S. Rey B.
metaDescription: Economist and lawyer. Research on financial intermediation, credit regulation and macroprudential policy. MA Economics candidate, Universidad de los Andes.
heading: Adolfo S. Rey B.
tagline: Economist and lawyer · Universidad de los Andes
body: I am an economist and lawyer working on credit regulation, financial intermediation and macroprudential policy. My research asks how the rules that govern the price of credit — and the structure of the banking system that supplies it — shape who gets a loan and how monetary policy travels through the financial system in emerging economies.

I am completing an MA in Economics at Universidad de los Andes, where I also hold a teaching appointment in the Department of Economics. I hold undergraduate degrees in Economics and Law from the same university, with minors in Mathematics and French. I am a Colombian–American economist based in Bogotá.

I lead the research agenda at Colombia Fintech, the industry association of Colombia's fintech sector, where I design the studies that produce the sector's reference statistics on digital lending, payments and financial inclusion, and build the empirical case behind regulatory proposals.
interests: Credit regulation and the industrial organization of credit markets
Banking intermediation, adverse selection and credit rationing
Monetary policy transmission through the financial system
Financial networks, contagion and systemic risk
Capital market development in emerging economies
